tables.caption: The six sensors restricted to the window in which all six were collecting, under both day definitions and both cutoffs. Restricting to a common window removes the unequal-record-length difference; it does not remove the unequal-seasonality one, because the window is entirely high summer and contains the smoke period. Neither these values nor DEQ's are comparable to the NAAQS.

tables.caption: The same statistic under three defensible method combinations, against the value DEQ published in Table 4 of its 2026-08-07 report. No single combination reproduces all nine rows, which is why this is reported as a partial reproduction. The day boundary accounts for most of the offset; zero handling is minor and inconsistent in direction.
